nodes.label: optics type
nodes.def: Abstracting getters/setters across product and sum types (lens, prism, traversal).

nodes.label: du variant
nodes.def: A named constituent of a discriminated union, pairing a du_tag with a du_payload type. Each variant represents one summand in the sum type.

nodes.label: lens optic
nodes.def: An optic pairing a getter with a setter over a product type's field, enabling focused access to one du_payload while preserving the rest of the product structure.

nodes.label: type inference
nodes.def: Compiler or runtime deducing types from context without explicit annotation.

nodes.label: discriminated union
nodes.def: Tagged union enabling compiler-verified exhaustive pattern matching over variants.

nodes.label: du tag
nodes.def: A value-level or type-level label that uniquely identifies which variant of a discriminated union is active in a given value. The tag is the first-class evidence of variant members

nodes.label: constraint solving
nodes.def: The phase that processes the generated constraints via unification, producing the principal substitution.

nodes.label: instantiation
nodes.def: Operation that replaces quantified variables in a type scheme with fresh type variables.

nodes.label: type variable
nodes.def: Placeholder symbol ranging over types, awaiting instantiation (alpha in Hindley-Milner).

nodes.label: algorithm w
nodes.def: The classic Hindley-Milner type_inference algorithm combining constraint_generation, most_general_unifier computation, and let-polymorphism generalization in a single pass producin

nodes.label: constraint
nodes.def: An atomic equational condition of the form type_A = type_B produced during constraint_generation, awaiting resolution by unification.

nodes.label: du payload
nodes.def: The data value carried by a specific variant of a discriminated union. Only one payload is live at a time; the tag selects which one.

nodes.label: generalization
nodes.def: Operation that abstracts free type variables into quantified variables, forming a type scheme.

nodes.label: prism optic
nodes.def: An optic pairing a matcher with a builder over a sum type's du_variant, enabling partial projection into one du_tag's du_payload with fallback to the original sum.

nodes.label: pt02
nodes.def: type_inference: the algorithmic process of deriving types for expressions by propagating constraints from known types through the syntax tree

nodes.label: pt09
nodes.def: instantiation: replacing quantified variables in a type scheme with fresh type variables, yielding a less-general type

nodes.label: substitution
nodes.def: A total function from type_variable to monotype; a mapping recording how each type_variable was solved during constraint_solving.

nodes.label: unification
nodes.def: The algorithm that, given two monotypes, computes a substitution that makes them syntactically identical, or reports a type_error if impossible.

nodes.label: algebraic data type
nodes.def: Type formed by sum (union) and product (record) of other types.

nodes.label: du match
nodes.def: The elimination form: a function that, given a discriminated union value, dispatches on its du_tag to apply the appropriate handler to the du_payload, yielding a uniform result typ

nodes.label: let polymorphism
nodes.def: The scoping discipline that generalizes the rhs of a let-binding at its point of definition, making its type_scheme available for instantiation at each use site.

nodes.label: optic compose
nodes.def: Composition rule: chaining optics so the du_payload of one becomes the structure operated on by the next, forming a pipeline that satisfies the optic laws transitively.

nodes.label: pt07
nodes.def: type_scheme: a type paired with quantified type variables, enabling polymorphism by separating generic from monomorphic occurrences

nodes.label: pt08
nodes.def: generalization: the operation that lifts free type variables into a type scheme, forming a polytype from a monotype

nodes.label: result type
nodes.def: Wrapper capturing either successful value or error without exceptions (Result<T, E>).

nodes.label: tagged union type
nodes.def: Discriminated union with explicit tag field enabling exhaustive pattern matching.

nodes.label: traversal optic
nodes.def: An optic generalizing lens and prism to target zero or more locations simultaneously, enabling fold and map operations over collections of du_payload within a structure.

nodes.label: type error
nodes.def: Violation of type constraints detected by the type system (static or runtime).

nodes.label: type scheme
nodes.def: Type with universally quantified variables; pairs a monotype with a set of type variables in scope.

nodes.label: constraint generation
nodes.def: The phase that walks the syntax tree of an expression under a type_environment, producing a set of constraints paired with an accumulating type_environment for subterms.

nodes.label: du exhaustiveness
nodes.def: The static guarantee that a du_match covers every du_variant of the discriminated union. The type system rejects non-exhaustive matches, ensuring no variant is silently ignored.

nodes.label: du inject
nodes.def: The introduction form for a discriminated union: given a variant label and a payload of the matching type, produce a value of the union type. Also called 'variant' or 'Left'/'Right

nodes.label: hindley milner
nodes.def: Classical type inference algorithm supporting parametric polymorphism and let-generalization.

nodes.label: monotype
nodes.def: Type with no quantified variables; ground type or type variable instantiation result.

nodes.label: most general unifier
nodes.def: Most general substitution that satisfies a set of type constraints; unique up to renaming of variables.

nodes.label: null safety
nodes.def: Type system preventing null dereference by distinguishing nullable from non-null types.

nodes.label: optic variance
nodes.def: Classification of an optic by its directional capability: getter-only (covariant, read-only), setter-only (contravariant, write-only), or full optic (both directions, lenses are th

nodes.label: prism builder
nodes.def: A constructor taking a du_payload and injecting it as the sole du_variant under a specific du_tag, rebuilding the sum type from the selected summand.

nodes.label: prism matcher
nodes.def: A partial function over a sum type that succeeds only when the active du_tag matches the target, yielding the contained du_payload; otherwise the sum is preserved.

nodes.label: pt01
nodes.def: principal_type: the unique most-general type that captures all valid typings for an expression, serving as the output of type inference

nodes.label: pt04
nodes.def: unification: the algorithm that finds the most general substitution making two types equal, central to constraint solving in inference

nodes.label: pt05
nodes.def: substitution: a mapping from type variables to types that, when applied, resolves all variables in a type expression

nodes.label: pt11
nodes.def: let_polymorphism: the polymorphism arising from let-bindings where the bound expression is generalized, giving it a principal type scheme

nodes.label: record type
nodes.def: Fixed set of named fields with individual types (struct in Rust, type alias in TypeScript).

nodes.label: type annotation
nodes.def: Explicit syntactic marker associating a name or expression with a type (e.g. x: int).

nodes.label: array type
nodes.def: Homogeneous mutable sequence with element type (list[int] in Python).

nodes.label: bidirectional type inference
nodes.def: A mode of type_inference splitting into two directions: synthesize (produce a type from an expression alone) and check (verify an expression against a given expected_type), compose

nodes.label: borrowing
nodes.def: Temporary access to data without taking ownership, with borrow checker enforcement.

nodes.label: boxing
nodes.def: Wrapping primitive value in heap-allocated object wrapper (int → Integer).

nodes.label: collection type
nodes.def: Generic container type (List[T], Set[T], Map[K,V]) with element type parameter.

nodes.label: ct bound variable
nodes.def: A type variable bound by a ∀ quantifier in a type scheme; subject to instantiation.

nodes.label: dependent type
nodes.def: Type that depends on a runtime value, enabling compile-time proofs about data.

nodes.label: du primitive
nodes.def: An untagged union of types without a du_tag. The discriminated union adds a tag to this primitive structure to make variant membership verifiable.

nodes.label: exhaustive check
nodes.def: Compiler verification that all cases of a union are handled in pattern matching.

nodes.label: existential type
nodes.def: Abstraction hiding a type (some T such that property holds) from consumers.

nodes.label: free type variables
nodes.def: Set of type variables occurring in a type that are not quantified; relevant to generalization.

nodes.label: generic type
nodes.def: Type or function parameterized by one or more type variables enabling code reuse across types.

nodes.label: higher kinded type
nodes.def: Type constructor taking another type as argument (Functor[F[_]] in Scala).

nodes.label: invariance
nodes.def: Generic has no subtyping relationship regardless of component types (mutable container).

nodes.label: lens getter
nodes.def: A pure projection from a product type to a specific du_payload at a named field, extracting only the target substructure without mutation.

nodes.label: lens setter
nodes.def: A mutation function taking a product type and a new du_payload value, returning a new product with only the target field replaced, leaving all other du_payload fields unchanged.

nodes.label: narrowing
nodes.def: Type refinement in conditional branches reducing possible types (v: int | str → v: int).

nodes.label: occurs check
nodes.def: The guard inside unification that rejects a substitution {α ↦ t} when α occurs free inside t, preventing the construction of infinite recursive types.

nodes.label: optic law get set
nodes.def: Law: applying lens_setter to the result of lens_getter on any product yields back the original du_payload value — get never lies about what set just wrote.

nodes.label: optic law set get
nodes.def: Law: applying lens_getter to the result of lens_setter on a product yields back the du_payload value that was set — set reflects exactly what get will retrieve.

nodes.label: optic law set set
nodes.def: Law: composing two lens_setter calls yields the same product as applying only the second one — idempotent in the face of duplicate mutation, last du_payload wins.

nodes.label: optic law unity
nodes.def: Law: the composition of a lens_setter with a lens_getter in reverse order yields a total transformation equivalent to the identity on du_payload — structural integrity preserved un

nodes.label: optional type
nodes.def: Value may be present (Some/T) or absent (None/Null) — nullable wrapper.

nodes.label: ownership
nodes.def: Linear resource management where exactly one owner is responsible for deallocation.

nodes.label: parametric polymorphism
nodes.def: Same implementation works uniformly over a range of types via type parameters.

nodes.label: phantom type
nodes.def: Type variable appearing only in output positions carrying compile-time metadata.

nodes.label: polytype
nodes.def: Synonym for type scheme; a type with forall-quantified variables enabling polymorphism.

nodes.label: principal pair
nodes.def: Pair consisting of a type scheme and its originating type environment; the full inference result.

nodes.label: pt03
nodes.def: type_variable: a placeholder symbol in a type that remains unresolved until unification binds it to a concrete or more general type

nodes.label: pt06
nodes.def: type_constraint: an equation of the form T1 = T2 between two types that must hold for a valid typing

nodes.label: pt10
nodes.def: most_general_unifier: the substitution produced by unification that is no more restrictive than any other unifier for the same types

nodes.label: pt12
nodes.def: type_equivalence_class: the set of all types reachable from a principal type via instantiation—types that are all valid typings of the same expression

nodes.label: recursive type
nodes.def: Type containing itself as component (linked list node: value + next node).

nodes.label: subtype relation
nodes.def: Partial ordering between types where subtype values can substitute supertype values.

nodes.label: type family
nodes.def: Type-level function mapping input types to output types (associated types in Rust traits).

nodes.label: type guard
nodes.def: Function narrowing union type to one branch based on runtime check (isinstance).

nodes.label: type parameter
nodes.def: Named placeholder within generic declaration awaiting concrete type argument.

nodes.label: type safe union
nodes.def: Tagged union with exhaustiveness guarantee preventing access without matching on tag.

nodes.label: type theory
nodes.def: Formal mathematical framework for studying types and their properties.

nodes.label: variance
nodes.def: Rules governing how subtyping relationships between type arguments affect parameterized types.

nodes.label: abstract type
nodes.def: Type requiring concrete implementations; cannot be instantiated directly.

nodes.label: ad hoc polymorphism
nodes.def: Same name denotes different implementations for different argument types (overloading).

nodes.label: applicative pattern
nodes.def: Lifted function application over wrapped values enabling multi-argument composition.

nodes.label: async result type
nodes.def: Asynchronous computation that may succeed with value or fail with error.

nodes.label: async type
nodes.def: Type representing asynchronous computation (Future[T], Promise<T>, Task<T>).

nodes.label: autoboxing
nodes.def: Automatic implicit boxing/unboxing between primitives and their wrapper types.

nodes.label: bottom type
nodes.def: Type with no values (never in TypeScript, Nothing in Scala) — uninhabited.

nodes.label: builder pattern
nodes.def: Fluent API constructing complex objects step-by-step with method chaining and type-safe setters.

nodes.label: casting
nodes.def: Explicit programmer assertion to interpret value as different type (unsafe in many langs).

nodes.label: class type
nodes.def: Object blueprint combining data fields, methods, and potentially inheritance.

nodes.label: codegen
nodes.def: Automatic generation of type-safe code from type definitions or schemas.

nodes.label: completeness
nodes.def: Type system accepts every valid program (relative to its formal semantics).

nodes.label: compound type
nodes.def: Type constructed from other types (tuple, array, object, function).

nodes.label: conditional type
nodes.def: Type-level conditional selecting between two types based on condition (T extends U ? X : Y).

nodes.label: constraint set
nodes.def: Set of type equality constraints generated during constraint-based type inference.

nodes.label: contravariance
nodes.def: Generic reverses subtyping direction for input positions (Consumer[-A]).

nodes.label: covariance
nodes.def: Generic preserves subtyping direction for output positions (Producer[+A]).

nodes.label: ct constraint
nodes.def: A type equality constraint τ₁ ~ τ₂ arising during inference; must be unified to complete typing.

nodes.label: ct expression
nodes.def: A program expression undergoing type inference; the subject of a typing judgment.

nodes.label: ct free variable
nodes.def: A type variable free in a type (not bound by a surrounding type scheme); scoped via the type environment.

nodes.label: ct fresh variable
nodes.def: A type variable generated during instantiation or constraint solving; distinct from all existing variables.

nodes.label: ct type
nodes.def: A type; the target of typing judgments; can be monomorphic or polymorphic.

nodes.label: ct type environment
nodes.def: The context Γ mapping term variables to their types or type schemes during inference.

nodes.label: ct type variable
nodes.def: A flexible type variable appearing in an inferred type; subject to unification and occurs-check.

nodes.label: curry howard correspondence
nodes.def: Isomorphism between types and logical propositions, programs and proofs.

nodes.label: du binary
nodes.def: A discriminated union with exactly two du_variant cases. Historically called 'Either' or sum-of-two; many algebraic laws simplify for the binary case.

nodes.label: du closed
nodes.def: A discriminated union whose variant set is fixed and final; no new variants can be introduced. Common in languages with sealed hierarchies or final sum types.

nodes.label: du open
nodes.def: A discriminated union that permits new variants to be added in extension modules or subtypes without breaking existing du_match arms. Contrast with du_closed.

nodes.label: error type
nodes.def: Type representing failure conditions as values rather than exceptions.

nodes.label: exists quantification
nodes.def: Existential quantifier over types meaning some hidden type T satisfies property.

nodes.label: forall quantification
nodes.def: Universal quantifier over types meaning property holds for all types T.

nodes.label: functor pattern
nodes.def: Mappable wrapper where map applies function to contained value preserving structure.

nodes.label: generic constraint
nodes.def: Bound restricting type variable to subset of types (T extends Comparable in Java).

nodes.label: gradual typing
nodes.def: Mixing statically-typed and dynamically-typed code with consistency checks at boundary.

nodes.label: interface type
nodes.def: Contract specifying required fields and/or methods without implementation details.

nodes.label: iso optic
nodes.def: A bidirectional optic between two types that are isomorphic, providing both a forward view and a reverse constructor with no information loss.

nodes.label: kind
nodes.def: Type of a type — arity classification (* is proper type, *→* is type constructor).

nodes.label: lens type
nodes.def: Composable accessor/mutator pair for nested immutable data structures.

nodes.label: lifetime
nodes.def: Region of code during which a reference remains valid (Rust lifetime annotations).

nodes.label: mapped type
nodes.def: Type transforming each member of another type (Record<K,V> in TypeScript).

nodes.label: memory safety
nodes.def: Guarantee preventing invalid memory access: buffer overflows, use-after-free, dangling pointers.

nodes.label: newtype pattern
nodes.def: Type wrapper distinguishing semantically different values of same representation.

nodes.label: nominal subtype
nodes.def: Subtyping relationship declared explicitly via class/interface inheritance.

nodes.label: nominal typing
nodes.def: Type compatibility determined by explicit declaration and name identity.

nodes.label: object type
nodes.def: Structured data bundling named fields and methods; blueprint for runtime instances.

nodes.label: option type
nodes.def: Explicit optional value type forcing handling of absence (Option[T], Maybe[T]).

nodes.label: predicative polymorphism
nodes.def: Polymorphism restricted to monomorphic types inside quantifiers (ML/Hindley-Milner).

nodes.label: primitive union
nodes.def: An untagged union of types representing a value that could be one of several member types, but without a discriminator tag or label to identify which variant is active at runtime.

nodes.label: principal type
nodes.def: Most general type capturing all valid typings for an expression.

nodes.label: protocol type
nodes.def: Structural type defining required methods without implementation (Swift protocol, Go interface).

nodes.label: pruning
nodes.def: The substitution-composition step that replaces a type_variable with its expanded form after unification, eliminating aliasing to type_variables.

nodes.label: pt13
nodes.def: free_type_variables: type variables occurring in an expression that are not bound by a surrounding lambda and thus subject to generalization

nodes.label: pt14
nodes.def: principal_type_theorem: the formal result guaranteeing that when a principal type exists, it is unique up to renaming of type variables

nodes.label: refined type
nodes.def: Base type restricted by a predicate (x: {v: int | v > 0}).

nodes.label: renaming
nodes.def: The fresh-variable generation step that replaces a type_variable with a distinct new type_variable during instantiation or when lifting quantifiers, ensuring no capture of free var

nodes.label: row polymorphism
nodes.def: Polymorphism over record shapes allowing extension while preserving existing fields.

nodes.label: sealed class
nodes.def: Class limited to known subtypes enabling compiler-verified exhaustive matching.

nodes.label: side effect
nodes.def: Observable state change beyond returning a value (I/O, mutation, throwing).

nodes.label: soundness
nodes.def: Type system property: well-typed programs cannot go wrong (Milner).

nodes.label: strict null checks
nodes.def: Compiler flag enforcing non-nullability preventing null assignment to non-nullable types.

nodes.label: structural subtype
nodes.def: Subtyping relationship inferred from having all required members of supertype.

nodes.label: structural typing
nodes.def: Type compatibility determined by shape of data (fields present) not by name.

nodes.label: subtype polymorphism
nodes.def: Code operates on values of a type and all its subtypes via inheritance hierarchy.

nodes.label: template literal type
nodes.def: Type computed from string literal allowing string manipulation at type level.

nodes.label: thread safety
nodes.def: Correct behavior of types and operations under concurrent access from multiple threads.

nodes.label: traversal fold
nodes.def: Operation over a traversal_optic that reduces all targeted du_payload within a structure to a single aggregate value, consuming the structure without producing a new one.

nodes.label: traversal map
nodes.def: Operation over a traversal_optic that applies a function to each du_payload in the targeted locations, producing a new structure with all positions updated.

nodes.label: tuple type
nodes.def: Fixed-length heterogeneous sequence with positional typing (x: tuple[int, str]).

nodes.label: type alias
nodes.def: Named shorthand for a complex type expression improving readability.

nodes.label: type annotations stub
nodes.def: Type hints file (.pyi) providing types without implementation for external libraries.

nodes.label: type argument
nodes.def: Concrete type substituted for type parameter at instantiation site.

nodes.label: type checking
nodes.def: Process of verifying that program expressions respect declared or inferred type constraints.

nodes.label: type coercion
nodes.def: Implicit automatic conversion from one type to another (e.g. int to float).

nodes.label: type environment
nodes.def: A finite mapping from term_variable names to type_schemes, providing the typing assumptions available at a given point during constraint_generation.

nodes.label: type erasure
nodes.def: Type information discarded during compilation (Java generics pre-14 reification).

nodes.label: type narrowing
nodes.def: Compiler inference of more specific type within control flow branch.

nodes.label: type projection
nodes.def: Accessing field or method of existential type while hiding the concrete type.

nodes.label: type safety
nodes.def: Property that a program cannot perform invalid operations on values of incorrect type.

nodes.label: type widening
nodes.def: Implicit conversion from narrow subtype to broader supertype.

nodes.label: typeshed
nodes.def: Centralized repository of standard library type stubs for Python type checkers.

nodes.label: unboxing
nodes.def: Extracting primitive value from its object wrapper.

nodes.label: union type
nodes.def: Value may be one of several alternative types (x: int | str in TypeScript).

nodes.label: universal type
nodes.def: Abstraction over all types (for all T, property holds) — parametric polymorphism.

nodes.label: variance annotation
nodes.def: Explicit (+/-/*) markers on type parameters declaring covariance/contravariance/invariance.

nodes.label: ct generalization
nodes.def: The operation that abstracts free type variables in a monotype to form a type scheme when binding a let-expression.

nodes.label: ct instantiation
nodes.def: The operation that replaces quantified variables in a type scheme with fresh type variables to obtain a monotype.

nodes.label: ct mgu
nodes.def: Most General Unifier; the unique (up to renaming) substitution that is more general than any other unifier of the same constraints.

nodes.label: ct most general
nodes.def: The property of a type being maximal under the instance relation; no other valid type is more general.

nodes.label: ct principal type
nodes.def: Most general type that captures all valid typings for an expression; all other valid types are instances of it via substitution.

nodes.label: ct substitution
nodes.def: A type substitution mapping type variables to types; the mechanism that relates principal type to its instances.

nodes.label: ct type scheme
nodes.def: A polymorphic type (polytype) of the form ∀α₁...αₙ. τ expressing that τ may be instantiated by replacing the quantified variables.

nodes.label: ct typing judgment
nodes.def: A judgment of the form Γ ⊢ e : τ asserting expression e has type τ under type environment Γ.

nodes.label: ct unification
nodes.def: The algorithm that computes the most general unifier of a set of type constraints; yields a substitution.

nodes.label: decorator pattern
nodes.def: Wrapping objects to add behavior at runtime without altering the wrapped type.

nodes.label: dependent pair
nodes.def: Pair where second component type depends on first component value.

nodes.label: deserialization
nodes.def: Reconstructing typed objects from serialized representation with type safety concerns.

nodes.label: dictionary type
nodes.def: Key-value mapping type (dict[K,V] in Python, Map<K,V> in Java).

nodes.label: du nominal
nodes.def: A discriminated union where each du_variant is identified by a distinct type name (nominal typing). The du_tag is implicit in the variant's name; runtime representation may be opti

nodes.label: du structural
nodes.def: A discriminated union where variants are distinguished by their shape (payload type) rather than by name. The du_tag must be stored at runtime to disambiguate structurally identica

nodes.label: duck typing
nodes.def: Typing based on object capabilities rather than declared type or inheritance.

nodes.label: dynamic typing
nodes.def: Type checking performed at runtime during execution.

nodes.label: effects system
nodes.def: Type-level tracking of side effects (IO, state, exceptions) beyond return type.

nodes.label: enum type
nodes.def: Fixed finite set of named constant values (enum in Python/Rust/TypeScript).

nodes.label: error union
nodes.def: Union of value type and error type representing failure as ordinary value.

nodes.label: exception safety
nodes.def: Guarantee about object and resource state when exceptions propagate.

nodes.label: factory pattern
nodes.def: Constructor abstraction returning possibly-different subtypes based on input parameters.

nodes.label: final type
nodes.def: Type or class that cannot be extended or subclassed (final in Java/Kotlin).

nodes.label: function type
nodes.def: Callable type specifying parameter types and return type (x: Callable[[int], str]).

nodes.label: generator type
nodes.def: Lazy sequence producing values via coroutine-like suspension (yield).

nodes.label: gradual guarantee
nodes.def: Removing static annotations preserves runtime behavior; adding them never breaks it.

nodes.label: impredicative polymorphism
nodes.def: Polymorphism allowing polymorphic types inside other types (System F — e.g. Java generics).

nodes.label: intersection type
nodes.def: Value must satisfy all constituent types simultaneously (A & B).

nodes.label: iterator type
nodes.def: Lazy traversal abstraction yielding elements one at a time on demand.

nodes.label: latent typing
nodes.def: Types implied by operations rather than declared; checked at use site.

nodes.label: liquid type
nodes.def: Refinement types with automatically inferred predicates using SMT solving.

nodes.label: manifest typing
nodes.def: Requiring explicit type declarations for all bindings (Java, C++).

nodes.label: mixin pattern
nodes.def: Composable behavior units mixed into classes via inheritance or composition.

nodes.label: monad pattern
nodes.def: Type wrapper with bind operation chaining computations with context (Result, Option).

nodes.label: most general
nodes.def: Property of a type such that no strictly more general type exists for the same expression.

nodes.label: mutually recursive type
nodes.def: Set of types referencing each other forming a cycle (AST node variants).

nodes.label: mypy
nodes.def: Static type checker for Python implementing PEP 484 type annotations.

nodes.label: null pointer
nodes.def: Reference pointing to absent object causing crash on dereference if unchecked.

nodes.label: opaque type
nodes.def: Type whose internal structure is hidden from consumers (abstract type with hidden representation).

nodes.label: polymorphic recursion
nodes.def: Recursive function where type argument differs between recursive calls.

nodes.label: primitive type
nodes.def: Built-in atomic types (int, float, bool, str) not composed from other types.

nodes.label: purity
nodes.def: Function producing same output for same input with no side effects.

nodes.label: pyright
nodes.def: Fast TypeScript-style type checker for Python using language server protocol.

nodes.label: referential transparency
nodes.def: Expression replaceable by its value without changing program behavior.

nodes.label: reified type
nodes.def: Type information preserved and accessible at runtime via reflection or generics reification.

nodes.label: resource leak
nodes.def: Failure to release acquired resources causing gradual exhaustion (file handles, memory).

nodes.label: runtime type checking
nodes.def: Validating values against types at runtime (pydantic, attrs, marshmallow).

nodes.label: schema validation
nodes.def: Verifying data structure conforms to schema (JSON Schema, OpenAPI, GraphQL SDL).

nodes.label: serialization
nodes.def: Transforming in-memory objects to transmittable/recordable format preserving type information.

nodes.label: set type
nodes.def: Collection of unique values with O(1) membership testing (set[T], HashSet<T>).

nodes.label: skolemization
nodes.def: Replacing type variable with fresh unknown type during type inference.

nodes.label: static typing
nodes.def: Type checking performed at compile-time before execution.

nodes.label: strategy pattern
nodes.def: Encapsulating swappable algorithms behind common interface for runtime selection.

nodes.label: strong typing
nodes.def: Language enforcement preventing implicit conversions between unrelated types.

nodes.label: supertype
nodes.def: Parent type higher in a type hierarchy; all subtypes are compatible with it.

nodes.label: top type
nodes.def: Supertype of all types (Any in Python/TypeScript, Object in Java) accepting any value.

nodes.label: type
nodes.def: Fundamental classification of values determining permissible operations and memory layout.

nodes.label: type checker
nodes.def: Static analysis tool verifying type constraints without executing the program.

nodes.label: type compatibility
nodes.def: Whether a value of one type may be assigned to a variable of another type.

nodes.label: type difference
nodes.def: Type with certain members excluded (TypeScript: string & {} excluding never).

nodes.label: type equality
nodes.def: Two types are exactly identical in structure and name (nominal or structural).

nodes.label: type extraction
nodes.def: Unwrapping type from container (Option[T] → T via unwrap or pattern match).

nodes.label: type intersection
nodes.def: Most specific common supertype of two types (greatest lower bound).

nodes.label: type isolation
nodes.def: Restricting which types may extend or implement a given type.

nodes.label: type naming convention
nodes.def: Systematic naming rules for types (PascalCase for classes, snake_case for Python).

nodes.label: type promotion
nodes.def: Implicit widening conversion along a type hierarchy (e.g. byte to int).

nodes.label: type safe builder
nodes.def: Builder preventing invalid intermediate states via phantom types encoding construction phase.

nodes.label: type substitution
nodes.def: Mapping from type variables to types; a function applied to types to resolve variables.

nodes.label: type union
nodes.def: Least upper bound of two types — value belonging to either type.

nodes.label: uniqueness up to rename
nodes.def: Property that any two principal types for the same expression differ only by renaming of type variables.

nodes.label: valid typing
nodes.def: A type that can be assigned to an expression under some type environment and substitution.

nodes.label: visitor pattern
nodes.def: Separating algorithm from object structure using accept/visit dispatch on typed data.

nodes.label: weak typing
nodes.def: Permissive type system allowing implicit conversions and pointer coercion.
